subject: Partner-sponsored trial top-up request — CloudBridge / AcmeFin
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@cloudbridge.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@acmefin.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the quick integration support last week. AcmeFin (Susan Li) just went through a PLG signup via CloudBridge marketplace and hit the initial free credit bucket. They have a PoC that could expand quickly if we can give them a little more runway.

CloudBridge is willing to sponsor an additional $5,000 in trial credits (to be applied to AcmeFin's Redwood account) to keep the momentum during their evaluation. Attached is CloudBridge's one-page approval memo with the partner sign-off.

Can Redwood apply these as account credits directly (acct id: acct_9876-AcmeFin), or would you prefer we issue a promo code that AcmeFin redeems?

We can finalize whichever is easier — hoping for same-day processing if possible since their demo is on Monday.

Attaching: cloudbridge_approval_signed.pdf

Best,
Marta Gomez
Partnerships, CloudBridge

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits

Marta — really appreciate this. Looping in Marissa (partnership ops) and Ben (finance/credits) to confirm the right flow.

Quick questions for clarity:
- Is CloudBridge's approval conditional on any specific usage restrictions (e.g., inference-only, embeddings only)?
- Do you need us to bill CloudBridge for reconciliation, or are they covering it directly as a partner-sponsored promo?

If we can do a direct account credit, that is fastest. If you prefer a promo code we can create one and share it for AcmeFin to redeem.

I'll expedite once ops and finance confirm.

— Rishi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits

Rishi / team —

Thanks, Marta, for the note and the signed approval doc. A couple of internal constraints to flag:
- Standard policy: partner-sponsored credits under $2,500 can be approved by ops. Anything above $2,500 requires finance sign-off and an audit trail (we need the partner-signed approval and a HubSpot link).
- We prefer issuing a promo code for traceability (so we can associate redemptions to the partner & campaign). Applying credits directly to an account is possible but we’ll need the exact Redwood account id and a ticket for the support team.

If CloudBridge is covering the cost directly and wants reconciliation, we will need an invoice request (we can generate a partner invoice after credit issuance).

Cc'ing Lauren for quick sign-off on the $5k figure. Marissa — can you confirm whether this should be created as a single promo code or two smaller codes (e.g., 2x $2,500) to fit approvals/process?

-Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits

Ben / Rishi —

I pulled the partner program playbook: for partner-sponsored credits we generally create a single partner promo code named by partner and month (helps with reporting). For amounts >$2.5k we still need finance sign-off but operations can prepare the code and the support ticket so issuance is quick once Lauren approves.

Marta — confirming we have the signed approval PDF (attached) and the AcmeFin account id acct_9876-AcmeFin. If you confirm CloudBridge's preference (promo code vs. direct credit + reconciliation), we'll proceed.

— Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 13:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits

Approve up to $5,000 for CloudBridge-sponsored promo for AcmeFin. Please follow these controls:
- Create promo code: PARTNER-CB-202602 (single use, applies to acct_9876-AcmeFin)
- Record the CloudBridge approval doc in HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/9876) and attach to the internal credit issuance ticket.
- Finance will generate a reconciliation invoice to CloudBridge after the promo is redeemed; include deal id RBW-3321 on the invoice.

Marissa/Ben — you have green light to prepare the code and the support ticket. Rishi — please confirm to Marta and Susan once done.

-Lauren

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@cloudbridge.io>, Susan Li <susan.li@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner top-up request for AcmeFin trial credits — promo code issued

Marta / Susan — great news: finance approved the sponsor credit. We've issued a single-use partner promo code for AcmeFin: PARTNER-CB-202602 (value $5,000).

Next steps:
- Marissa has created the internal ticket and attached CloudBridge's signed approval.
- Support will apply the code to acct_9876-AcmeFin on first redemption (we've restricted it to that account and set expiration to 2026-03-31).
- Finance will send CloudBridge an invoice for the sponsored amount referencing RBW-3321.

Attachments: promo-code.csv (contains the code stub), cloudbridge_approval_signed.pdf

If you need the credit applied directly rather than via redemption, let me know and we can convert — but promo flow keeps the audit trail intact.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

— Rishi
